functions.name: start
functions.doc: From a menu entry's action: opens Training Mode's character select, and the Training match after it is the drill's. `drill` is the drill's mod id, what drill() answers; `stage` the stage the stage select starts on, as a content id ("melee/final-destination"), or ""; `keep_cpu` leaves Training's CPU in; `keep_screen` leaves Training's readouts on screen.

functions.name: drill
functions.doc: The drill this Training Mode was started for (its mod id), or nil.

functions.name: reset_here
functions.doc: Keeps this moment as the reset point, replacing the last; "Ready" shows. In a match only.

functions.name: reset
functions.doc: Puts the match back to the reset point, with "Reset" on screen when `say` is true (a reset the player asked for; a drill's own resets after every try are quiet). True if there was one.

functions.name: has_reset
functions.doc: True once a reset point is kept in this match.
